program='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    components = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] != 1 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for ny, nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and grid[ny][nx] == 1 and (ny,nx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((ny,nx))
                        q.append((ny,nx))
            components.append(cells)
    cells = max(components, key=len)
    r0 = min(r for r, c in cells)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in cells)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
    src = [row[c0:c1+1] for row in grid[r0:r1+1]]
    sh, sw = len(src), len(src[0])
    out = [[0] * sh for _ in range(sw)]
    for r in range(sh):
        for c in range(sw):
            out[sw-1-c][sh-1-r] = src[r][c]
    return out
'''
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
p.write_text(program)
exec(compile(program, str(p), 'exec'))
print('wrote',p)
